description: The neutral card layout catalogue of the O_o model format (.oos). Fields are ordered record values; slots connect them to card readers and writers. Groups describe repeated values, sections contain a neutral key and their fields, and forms select another layout from preceding values. Generated from source slot traces and reviewed model-format layouts. docs/model-format-cards.md is generated from this catalogue.

CosimulationArea.note: a list of IDs may hold THRU between two IDs (a range)

DirectMatrix.note: a value of a column is a real (the element of the next row), an integer (the row of the element that follows) or THRU then a row (the element above repeated down to it)

FailureMat.note: criterionValue11, criterionValue12 and strainLimit1 hold a word for the criteria that take one there (102: the failure method; 105: the cap type and the iteration)

RigidBodySearched.note: a list of nodes may hold THRU between two nodes (a range)
